findings.quote: Late-life mental gains come from sustained effort rather than from music specifically.
findings.note: Blind eliminations without the passage: A is a superlative overclaim ('the most effective way'), D is an overclaim ('proves'), and B is off-scope because sibling stems (q2 'volunteers who practiced regularly', its option D 'Older beginners') establish an adult-beginner cohort, not childhood training. That leaves C. Mechanism is form plus cross-question corroboration, not passage content; distractors remain substantive positions, so major/flag rather than lethal.

findings.quote: Every participant improved dramatically once the sixteen-week course had ended.
findings.note: Universal quantifier plus 'dramatically' makes B non-viable on form alone; D ('Older beginners tend to progress faster on string instruments than younger ones') is a general claim that does not fit the stem's scope ('the volunteers who practiced regularly'); C's magnitude ('well over ten hours in a typical week') is implausible for a beginner course. The hedged specific option A survives blind; two of the three eliminations are pure form.

findings.quote: The readers showed no measurable improvement on the attention tasks at all.
findings.note: The sibling stem q4 ('the improvements in both groups') presupposes that the comparison group improved, which retires A passage-blind; C is a study-design oddity rather than a reported finding. B vs D is not decided blind, but the field is halved by cross-question presupposition alone.

findings.quote: The regular, effortful, social routine that both activities happened to share.
findings.note: Stem echo: the prompt asks what caused 'the improvements in both groups' and B is the only option naming a property both groups share ('that both activities happened to share'); A is cello-specific and therefore excluded by the stem's own scope; C is an absolute ('fully accounted for every participant's gain'). D (test-retest) stays substantive, so major rather than lethal, but the stem-option lexical echo is a real form tell.

findings.quote: Reserved: the writer finds the claim appealing but thinks the evidence points elsewhere.
findings.note: Hedged-among-absolutes attitude set: B 'Convinced ... is sure', C 'Dismissive ... obvious wishful nonsense', D 'expects music will prove uniquely powerful' are all extreme stances, leaving the single measured option as the standard key shape. Authentic HP attitude items share this shape, so flag not kill.

findings.quote: Vid ängarna närmast lyktorna ökade de nattaktiva fjärilarnas besök märkbart, medan ängar längre bort inte förändrades.
findings.note: A inverts the causal direction the stem fixes (it makes the switch-off the consequence, not the result); B is absolute ('så gott som samtliga ängar ... alldeles oavsett avståndet'); and the sibling stem q4 ('de ängar som låg längre än hundra meter från lampraden') presupposes a distance-dependent effect, which is exactly what D asserts. Decidable blind via form plus cross-question presupposition.

findings.quote: Lyktans sken överröstar det svaga horisontljus som fjärilarna orienterar sig efter, så att de cirklar kring lampan i stället.
findings.note: A is the textbook transverse-orientation / light-trap mechanism, so a solver who knows moth navigation picks it without the text; B ('bränner ... ögon ... helt blinda') and D ('Blommornas doft försvinner i lampljuset') are wrong-mechanism distractors rather than filler, and C is a plausible light-avoidance stance weakened only by 'helt'. Domain knowledge, not form, decides it, so WORLD_KNOWLEDGE / flag per the calibration.

findings.quote: En enkel och billig mörkläggning kan ge nattens pollinatörer tillbaka, men effekten är begränsad och beror på platsen.
findings.note: Main-idea set with the standard shape: A and D are single-detail options (orientation mechanism; fältgentianans pollinationsberoende) and B is an absolute policy overreach ('nästan överallt ... i så gott som hela landskapet'), leaving the one hedged summary. Three blind eliminations, none needing the passage.

findings.quote: De borde rimligen ha gynnats allra mest av släckningen, eftersom de låg längst bort från det starka ljuset.
findings.note: D is logically inverted (farthest from the light means least to gain from removing it), A is an absolute ('saknade helt'), C is a non-sequitur recycling the honeybee distractor; and q1's option D already states that distant meadows did not change, so B follows without the passage. Cross-question corroboration inside the stems sheet.

findings.quote: Learning the cello is the most effective way to sharpen an aging mind.
findings.note: Superlative overreach ('the most effective way') is eliminable on form alone in a main-idea item; no passage needed.

findings.quote: New research proves the aging brain loses its plasticity far more slowly than assumed.
findings.note: 'proves' is an unhedged absolute — the second form-only elimination. That leaves B vs C at chance, so the item is materially better than 50/50 blind but not decided.

findings.quote: Every participant improved dramatically once the sixteen-week course had ended.
findings.note: Universal quantifier plus intensifier ('Every ... dramatically') — a no-domain reader discards it by form.

findings.quote: Older beginners tend to progress faster on string instruments than younger ones.
findings.note: Scope mismatch with the stem: a generic trend claim, not a report about 'the volunteers who practiced regularly'. Two form eliminations leave A vs C, with A the only hedged report-shaped option (near-leak).

findings.quote: The readers improved considerably more than the musicians on every measure.
findings.note: 'on every measure' — unhedged universal, discardable by form.

findings.quote: The comparison group seemed to combine some instrument practice with their weekly reading.
findings.note: Self-defeating design claim (a comparison group doing the treatment) reads as filler. Also cross-question: q:4's stem presupposes 'the improvements in both groups', which retires A and decides D without the passage.

findings.quote: The particular skills of cello playing, such as timing and finger control.
findings.note: Stem entailment: the prompt asks what caused improvement in BOTH groups, so a cello-only cause is eliminated by the stem, no passage required.

findings.quote: The friendships formed in class, which fully accounted for every participant's gain.
findings.note: 'fully accounted for every' — absolute overreach. Only B and D survive as shared causes, and B mirrors the stem's 'both groups' wording.

findings.quote: Dismissive: the writer treats the claim as obvious wishful nonsense.
findings.note: Extreme attitude label ('obvious wishful nonsense') — form-only elimination in an attitude item.

findings.quote: Convinced: the writer is sure music holds an unmeasured power over memory.
findings.note: Unhedged certainty about something explicitly 'unmeasured' is self-undercutting. B and D also sit on the same side of the claim, which weakens both; A vs D remains open within the question, but q:4's common-cause framing points to A.

findings.quote: Att allt fler nattfjärilar dök upp fick till slut forskarna att släcka en del av vägbelysningen.
findings.note: Causal reversal: the option states a cause of the switch-off, so it cannot answer 'resultatet av att ... släcktes'. Eliminated by stem logic alone.

findings.quote: Antalet honungsbin steg kraftigt på de mörklagda ängarna.
findings.note: Option-cluster tell: three options are about nattfjärilar, this one alone about honungsbin — the odd-topic option reads as filler from form, no ecology needed.

findings.quote: Släckningen mångdubblade fjärilslivet vid så gott som samtliga ängar utmed vägen, alldeles oavsett avståndet till lyktorna.
findings.note: Stacked absolutes ('mångdubblade', 'så gott som samtliga', 'alldeles oavsett'). With A and C gone as filler, the hedged distance-qualified D is the only remaining coherent option — three form-only eliminations decide the item passage-blind.

findings.quote: Lyktans sken överröstar det svaga horisontljus som fjärilarna orienterar sig efter, så att de cirklar kring lampan i stället.
findings.note: Edited stem judged fresh. The stem's 'svårare ... att hitta fram' frames the effect as a navigation failure, and A is the textbook phototaxis/celestial-orientation mechanism, so domain knowledge names the pick. But B (dazzle/eye damage) and D (scent masking) are articulable wrong hypotheses rather than filler, and C is only retired by the common fact that moths approach light — this is world-knowledge answerability, not a form leak. Stem no longer telegraphs a mechanism by wording.

findings.quote: Konstgjord belysning slår sannolikt ut pollineringen nästan överallt och bör därför avvecklas i så gott som hela landskapet.
findings.note: Absolute policy overreach ('nästan överallt', 'i så gott som hela landskapet') — discardable by form in a huvudbudskap item.

findings.quote: Skymningsglim är helt beroende av insekter för att kunna föröka sig.
findings.note: Scope mismatch: a single-species detail offered as a main message, plus 'helt beroende'. Two form eliminations leave A vs C genuinely open within the question; only the sibling stems (q:1, q:4, both about the darkening trial) settle it on C.

findings.quote: De borde rimligen ha gynnats allra mest av släckningen, eftersom de låg längst bort från det starka ljuset.
findings.note: Internally self-contradictory: the stated reason (farthest from the light) entails least exposure and therefore least to gain, so the option refutes itself without any passage.

findings.quote: De saknade helt nattaktiva fjärilar och kunde därför inte påverkas av försöket.
findings.note: 'saknade helt' — absolute, and incoherent for meadows only 100 m from a road.

findings.quote: De hade fler honungsbin som vägde upp för de uteblivna nattfjärilarna.
findings.note: Same odd-topic filler tell as q:1 (honungsbin among moth options). Three form-only eliminations leave B as the sole coherent option — the item is decided blind.

findings.quote: Antalet honungsbin steg kraftigt på de mörklagda ängarna.
findings.note: Surviving odd-topic tell from the previous version: three options talk about nattfjärilar, this one alone about honungsbin. A reader with no ecology sees the topic asymmetry from form and drops it. One elimination only, so not decisive.

findings.quote: Vid ängarna närmast lyktorna ökade de nattaktiva fjärilarnas besök märkbart, medan ängar längre bort inte förändrades.
findings.note: D is the distance-qualified option and it is corroborated across the unit: q:4's 'påverkades sannolikt inte nämnvärt ... redan från början' and q:3's 'beror på platsen' both presuppose exactly D's near/far split. Within this stem alone A (mixed/null seed-set result) and B (more than doubled) stay live, so it is partial, not decided by form.

findings.quote: Lyktans sken överröstar det svaga horisontljus som fjärilarna orienterar sig efter, så att de cirklar kring lampan i stället.
findings.note: Judged fresh. Domain knowledge names A: celestial/horizon-light orientation and the resulting orbiting of lamps is the textbook mechanism. But the distractors are articulable naive hypotheses, not filler — B (dazzle/eye damage), D (scent masked by light) and C (light-avoidance) are misconceptions a test author writes on purpose, and C only falls to the everyday fact that moths approach lamps. World-knowledge answerability, no form leak; the stem does not telegraph a mechanism.

findings.quote: Konstgjord belysning slår sannolikt ut pollineringen nästan överallt och bör därför avvecklas i så gott som hela landskapet.
findings.note: Stacked absolutes plus a policy leap ('nästan överallt', 'i så gott som hela landskapet') — discardable by form in a huvudbudskap item.

findings.quote: Skymningsglim är helt beroende av insekter för att kunna föröka sig.
findings.note: Altitude mismatch: a single-species detail with 'helt' offered as a main message. Two form eliminations, but A ('Studien visar framför allt hur nattfjärilar orienterar sig ...') is a genuine competitor at summary altitude, so A vs C is not settled inside this stem. What tips C is the sibling stems (q:1, q:4) being about the släckning trial and its place-dependence — cross-question, not form.

findings.quote: De hade fler honungsbin som vägde upp för de uteblivna nattfjärilarna.
findings.note: Same odd-topic filler tell as q:1 (honungsbin among moth options), and the repeat across two stems makes it read as a recycled slot rather than a live hypothesis. Eliminable by form.

findings.quote: De bör ha blivit sämre för fjärilarna, eftersom insekterna nu drogs till de mörklagda ängarna närmare lampraden i stället.
findings.note: No longer self-contradictory — the redistribution mechanism is coherent, so the previous lethal is repaired. It is however mutually exclusive with q:1's D ('ängar längre bort inte förändrades'): solving either stem retires this option in the other. Two eliminations leave A (too few moths to measure) vs B (already outside the light's reach) genuinely open on form; B is favoured only by physical reasoning about light attenuation over 100 m, i.e. domain knowledge, not structure.
